title: AIDE: AI-Driven Exploration in the Space of Code

mechanism.domainTask: LLM-guided search over executable machine-learning engineering code
mechanism.populationDetail: All discovered scripts are retained as nodes in a solution tree whose edges represent improvement attempts.
mechanism.archiveDetail: No separate elite archive is described; the final answer is the maximum-scoring solution among the root and generated nodes.
mechanism.replacementDetail: The tree is simultaneously the persistent candidate store and genealogy; it should not be collapsed into a single incumbent or mislabeled as a separate elite archive.
mechanism.generationDetail: AIDE drafts initial scripts from scratch and also repairs or makes targeted changes to one selected parent script; it does not fuse multiple parents.
mechanism.feedbackDetail: The tree summarizer reuses performance metrics, hyperparameter settings, and debugging hints/tracebacks in later coding prompts; dataset preview metadata is also supplied.
mechanism.parentSelectionDetail: The policy typically targets the best non-buggy solution for improvement and selects an eligible buggy node for debugging; exact tie-breaking is not specified.

provenance.citationWarning: Generation is genuinely hybrid across de novo drafting and unary parent repair/improvement; distinguish adaptive operator choice from an explicit explore/exploit controller. The model backbone varies across separate evaluations, not concurrently within a run. Exact node tie-breaking and complete prompt templates are not exposed.
